_comment: TEMPLATE — NOT part of realm-export.prod.json. Register ONE of these so a native/
loopback MCP client (MCP Inspector, mcp-remote, Claude Desktop connector, VS Code MCP)
can complete authorization-code + PKCE against the gallery realm. This is the OAuth
*client* the MCP tool authenticates as; the gallery_mcp sidecar is the resource server.
See gallery_mcp/README.md and ADR 0004 / ADR 0005.
PUBLIC client, not confidential: native MCP clients are public apps and cannot keep a
secret. Security rests on PKCE-S256 + exact redirect-URI matching, NOT a client_secret.
(The org-deployed-client.json template is the OTHER shape — confidential, for server-side
chat clients that CAN hold a secret. Do not confuse the two.)
WHY NOT DYNAMIC CLIENT REGISTRATION: the MCP spec would have the client self-register at
Keycloak's registration_endpoint. v1 does NOT enable DCR (ADR 0004 — it's the upgrade
path), so you pre-register this ONE static client and configure its client_id into the
MCP tool. An MCP client that ONLY supports DCR cannot connect until DCR is enabled.
REDIRECT URIs: loopback apps listen on an ephemeral port, so a single fixed URI rarely
matches. Options, in order of preference:
- Pin the port in the client (e.g. `mcp-remote --callback-port 6274`) and register the
exact URI, e.g. "http://127.0.0.1:6274/oauth/callback".
- Or keep the wildcard entries below. Keycloak matches redirect URIs literally with an
optional trailing `*`; the port is part of the match. If login fails with
`invalid_redirect_uri`, Keycloak's error page shows the exact URI the client tried —
add that string here verbatim (with a trailing /* ) and retry.
The entries below cover MCP Inspector's default (6274) and bare loopback hosts.
The gallery-defaults scope (default on every client) supplies aud=prompt-gallery-api,
org_id, sub and realm_access.roles automatically. prompt:read is a default scope so the
read-only MVP tools work with a plain login and no extra scope requests.
Delete this _comment key if your import tooling rejects unknown properties.
name: MCP client (native / loopback)
description: Public authorization-code + PKCE (S256) client for native MCP tools connecting through the gallery_mcp sidecar. Pre-registered per ADR 0004 (no DCR in v1).
